0x100342A0.name: CYyModelBase_AllocMatrixBuffers
0x100342A0.evidence: reads the count at +0x32 of the resource from ResourceHandle_Deref, allocates (count + 1) * 0x40 bytes with Mem_AllocObject and sets each 0x40-byte matrix there to the identity with Mat4_SetIdentity, then allocates a second buffer of count bytes; frees both on failure; called by CYyModelBase::SetResourceAndRebuild
0x100342A0.summary: Allocates the matrix buffers for a model's resource.
